definitions.english: Free from guile or artfulness; ingenuous and straightforward in manner.
definitions.example: Her artless conversation revealed a genuine kindness that put everyone at ease.

definitions.english: Lacking art, skill, or adornment; simple and natural in style or execution.
Unpretentious and without artificiality; appearing crude or unrefined due to simplicity.

collocations: artless + noun (e.g., artless charm)（an artless charm）
be + artless (e.g., be artless in approach)（She was artless in her approach to …
